stories.headline: DOJ sues to block Alaska Senate certification if Sen. Sullivan narrowly loses
stories.summary: The Justice Department sued to stop Alaska from certifying its Senate result if Republican Sen. Dan Sullivan loses narrowly, citing possible confusion with a same-named candidate. AG Todd Blanche said Sunday the suit is not an attempt to control state elections; election officials say they are preparing for federal interference before the Nov. 3 midterms.

firstHand.role: CNN's State of the Union, Oct. 25
firstHand.quote: President Trump is not trying to take over a state election in any way, shape, or form. We're not laying any groundwork for the president to do that.

stories.headline: Trump calls Michigan Senate nominee El-Sayed a 'jihadist'; Arab Americans for Trump founder calls it racist
stories.summary: At a Port Huron, Michigan rally, President Trump repeatedly called Democratic Senate nominee Abdul El-Sayed a 'jihadist' without offering evidence. Bishara Bahbah, a founder of Arab Americans for Trump, called the remarks racist; El-Sayed has denied any extremist ties.

firstHand.role: Grand Rapids rally, Oct. 24-25 (reported by AP/PBS)
firstHand.quote: He can just go on and call me 'senator' after November. I will be Senator Muhammad to you, bro.

firstHand.who: Bishara Bahbah, founder of Arab Americans for Trump
firstHand.quote: The president's statements are out of line. They are crossing a red line. They are racist.

stories.headline: Florida telemedicine owner gets 20 years for $46.2M Medicare fraud
stories.summary: Christopher Harwood, 44, owner of Fort Lauderdale-based TelevisitMD, was sentenced Oct. 23 to 20 years for a $46.2 million scheme billing Medicare for braces and genetic tests patients didn't need. Medicare paid $17.9 million; he must repay $17,942,402 and forfeit $10,431,463.

stories.headline: Administration unveils seafood strategy: voluntary 'U.S.-Caught' label, $5B+ in USDA loan guarantees
stories.summary: The administration released an America First Seafood Strategy with a voluntary 'U.S.-Caught' label under FDA draft guidance and at least $5 billion in USDA SPUR loan guarantees for seafood, meat and poultry processing. About 80% of seafood Americans eat is imported.

stories.headline: Saudi, Pakistani, Turkish delegations in Tehran to head off renewed Iran-Israel-US fighting
stories.summary: Saudi Defense Minister Khalid bin Salman, Pakistani army chief Asim Munir and Turkish intelligence chief Ibrahim Kalin are meeting Iranian officials in Tehran to prevent renewed fighting involving Iran, Israel and the US.

firstHand.who: Rayed Krimly, Saudi Deputy Minister for Public Diplomacy
firstHand.role: Post on X, Oct. 26 (quoted by CBS/AFP)
firstHand.quote: The visit comes as part of the continued efforts by the Makkah Joint Defense Agreement countries for de-escalation between parties involved in the ongoing crisis.

stories.whyItMattersToUS: US forces, including a third carrier group, are in the region, and Brent crude near $115 a barrel is pushing up US fuel prices.

stories.headline: Lula wins Brazil runoff 51.8% to 48.2%; Flávio Bolsonaro refuses to concede
stories.summary: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva won Brazil's runoff with 51.8% to Flávio Bolsonaro's 48.2%, a margin of about 4.4 million votes. Bolsonaro refused to concede and said he would seek to annul the election over a voting-hours extension both campaigns had requested.

firstHand.who: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, President of Brazil
firstHand.role: Victory speech, Oct. 25 (full text via UOL)
firstHand.quote: A defeat for denialism... a defeat for lies. (translated from Portuguese)
It is impossible to recognize the result of the elections... I will ask for the annulment of these elections. (translated from Portuguese)

stories.whyItMattersToUS: Trump loses a would-be ally in Latin America's largest economy, and Lula favors domestic control of the critical minerals Washington wants.
